svg.title: How to read the mixing-time chart (MSH Fig. 9.15)
svg.text: How to read the mixing-time chart (MSH Fig. 9.15)
Reynolds number, Re = n Dₐ² ρ / μ
dashed lines: unbaffled tanks; solid line: baffled tank
Compute Re = n D_a² ρ/μ and mark it on the bottom axis.
Go up to the line for your agitator (solid: baffled turbine; dashed: unbaffled tanks).
Go across to the left axis.
Read the mixing-time factor n·tₜ, then·tₜ = (n·tₜ)/n.
(digitized); in the exam read the printed chart — values may differ slightly.
